capabilities: Auto-arrange maps to the right, left, up, down or both sides
Build and navigate maps from the keyboard
Edit the map as an indented outline
Snapshot map history and export to FreeMind, OPML or Markdown
disambiguation: Not a thought-capture or journaling tool; it adds mind-map structure on top of ordinary Canvas files.
extras: Relies on Canvas internals outside Obsidian's public API, so a future Obsidian update may require a plugin update. Collapsed branches are stored in the canvas file and should be expanded before uninstalling. No network access or telemetry; English and Spanish interface.
intentEvidence: Turn Obsidian's Canvas into a mind-mapping tool, in the spirit of iThoughts
problem: Canvas draws cards and arrows but offers no branch collapsing, automatic mind-map layout, outline view or export to mind-mapping formats.

relations.evidence: Turn Obsidian's Canvas into a mind-mapping tool, in the spirit of iThoughts

summary: Mind-mapping layer for Obsidian Canvas with collapsible branches, automatic layout, keyboard building, an outline panel, snapshots and export.
